title: An upper bound for the type of a numerical semigroup, and a reduction of Wilf's conjecture
summary:
Let $S$ be a numerical semigroup with multiplicity $\mult$, conductor $\cc$, embedding dimension $\ee$, type $	yp$ and genus $\gnus$, and let $
n=\cc-\gnus$. Wilf's conjecture asserts that $\ee\,
n\ge\cc$; the inequality $\gnus\le	yp\,
n$ of Fröberg, Gottlieb and Häggkvist settles it when $	yp\le\ee-1$. The Apéry set of $S$ with respect to any $s\in S\setminus\{0\}$ carries a partial order whose maximal elements are the pseudo-Frobenius numbers translated by $s$; for $s=\mult$ its minimal elements are the minimal generators other than $\mult$.
